---
title: "Lifeform Summary"
format:
  html:
    theme: journal
params:
  plot_number: "00000"
  db_path: "../data/vpro.duckdb"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(duckdb)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

options(knitr.table.format = "html")
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), params$db_path, read_only = TRUE)
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
veg <- dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "SELECT * FROM vw_USysAllVeg WHERE PlotNumber = ?",
  list(params$plot_number)
)

dbDisconnect(con)

lifeform_col <- NULL
for (candidate in c("Lifeform", "lifeform", "LifeForm")) {
  if (candidate %in% names(veg)) {
    lifeform_col <- candidate
    break
  }
}
```

# Plot: `r params$plot_number`

```{r lifeform-table, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(lifeform_col) && nrow(veg) > 0) {
  summary <- veg %>%
    group_by(.data[[lifeform_col]]) %>%
    summarise(records = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(records))

  names(summary)[1] <- "Lifeform"

  kbl(summary, align = "l") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("Lifeform field not available in vw_USysAllVeg.")
}
```
